name: FIN_ASST_CASE_PAT_INCOME
description: This table contains income-related information for a financial assistance record, as reported by the patient.

columns.name: FIN_ASST_CASE_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the case record.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: PAT_INCOME_TYPE_C_NAME
columns.description: This item stores the types of income sources entered by the patient.

columns.name: PAT_INCOME_FREQ_C_NAME
columns.description: How often the income is received entered by the patient.

columns.name: PAT_INCOME_HOURS_PER_WEEK
columns.description: If income is hourly, the number of hours per week entered by the patient.

columns.name: PAT_INCOME_AMOUNT
columns.description: This item stores the income earned per frequency entered by the patient.

columns.name: PAT_INCOME_COMMENT
columns.description: This item stores the comment entered by a patient for the current income information row.
